name: Brentwood paired mini-roundabouts (area-inspired)
description: Area-inspired layout of the paired mini-roundabouts at High Street, Ingrave Road, Wilson's Corner, Shenfield Road and Ongar Road, Brentwood. Not an official test route. Road centrelines and building outlines from OpenStreetMap; lane counts and widths simplified; pavement widths to the shop fronts derived from map data; buildings marked approximate are placeholders where the map has no outline; traffic signals are not simulated (an exercise may hold them at green).

sources.title: OpenStreetMap
sources.notes: API 0.6 map call, bbox 0.3020,51.6195,0.3090,51.6232, downloaded 2026-10-17. Generated by tools/brentwood/build_location.py; way ids per road in docs/brentwood/SOURCES.md.
